results.question: I need at least 22 kW on propane and want the quietest qualifying generator. Which should I consider?
results.answer:
The models that meet the ≥ 22 kW propane (LP) rating and have the same low‑noise “Quiet‑Test™” level (57 dB(A) at 23 ft) are:

* **G007209‑10** – 24 000 W LP, Quiet‑Test 57 dB(A)【1】
* **G007042‑10** – 22 000 W LP, Quiet‑Test 57 dB(A)【2】
* **G007042‑11** – 22 000 W LP, Quiet‑Test 57 dB(A)【3】
* **G007043‑10** – 22 000 W LP, Quiet‑Test 57 dB(A)【8】
* **G007043‑11** – 22 000 W LP, Quiet‑Test 57 dB(A)【10】
* **G007291‑0** – 26 000 W LP, Quiet‑Test 57 dB(A)【5】
* **G007290‑0** – 26 000 W LP, Quiet‑Test 57 dB(A)【11】

All of these generators provide at least 22 kW on propane and share the same quiet‑mode sound level, so any of them would satisfy the requirement. The highest‑capacity options (G007291‑0 or G007290‑0) give the most power margin while remaining equally quiet.

results.question: Which generator would you recommend if low noise matters more than maximum power?
results.answer:
A good choice when quiet operation is more important than the highest power output is the **G007175‑0**.  
It delivers 13 kW of continuous power (LP/NG) while its sound level is only **65 dB(A)** at normal load and drops to **55 dB(A)** in Quiet‑Test mode【8】. This makes it one of the quietest models in the list, while still providing a respectable 13 kW capacity.

Section: Evolution™ Controls

[Page 2] AUTO/MANUAL/OFF illuminated buttons: Select the operating mode and provide easy, at-a-glance status indication in any condition.

[Page 2] Two-line multilingual LCD: Provides homeowners easily visible logs of history, maintenance, and events up to 50 occurrences.

[Page 2] Sealed, raised buttons: Smooth, weather-resistant user interface for programming and operations.

[Page 2] Utility voltage sensing: Constantly monitors utility voltage, setpoints 65% dropout, 80% pick-up, of standard voltage.

[Page 2] Generator voltage sensing: Constantly monitors generator voltage to verify the cleanest power is delivered to the home.

[Page 2] Utility interrupt delay: Prevents nuisance startups of the engine, adjustable 2-1500 seconds from the factory default setting of 5 seconds by a qualified dealer.

[Page 2] Engine warm-up: Verifies engine is ready to assume the load. Setpoint approximately 5 seconds.

[Page 2] Engine cool-down: Allows engine to cool prior to shutdown. Setpoint approximately 1 minute.

[Page 2] Programmable exercise: Operates engine to prevent oil seal drying and damage between power outages by running the generator for 5 minutes every other week. Offers a selectable setting for weekly or monthly operation, providing flexibility and potentially lower fuel costs to the owner.

[Page 2] Smart battery charger: Delivers charge to the battery only when needed at varying rates depending on outdoor air temperature. Compatible with lead acid and AGM-style batteries.

[Page 2] Main line circuit breaker: Protects generator from overload.

[Page 2] Electronic governor: Maintains constant 60 Hz frequency.
